grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To create a secure account for ordering and to process payment

grants.description: Process payment by debit or credit card for the certificate order
grants.purpose: To collect the certificate fee (£12.50 standard, £38.50 priority, plus £3.50 per search if no GRO reference)

grants.description: Provide the postal address where certificates should be sent
grants.purpose: To dispatch the certified death certificate(s) to you by post

grants.description: Access the death record from GRO index to verify details and produce certificate
grants.purpose: To locate the correct death registration and produce certified copies

grants.description: Save your order details to your GRO account for future reference
grants.purpose: To allow you to track your order and reorder certificates if needed

revocation.mechanism: Contact GRO by phone (0300 123 1837) or email, or revoke through your GRO online account
revocation.effect: Order will be cancelled if consent is revoked before dispatch. Refund may be issued for unprocessed orders.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf. Agent cannot change delivery address without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot access full death record details beyond what is needed to verify the correct registration. Agent cannot order certificates for deaths outside England and Wales.
